description: Silver Sabre mounted on a pylon in front of the Army, Navy and Air Force Veterans Club Unit 302. AerialVisuals records it as a Sabre 5, c/n 0850; Skaarup's British Columbia page calls it a Sabre Mk VI - the mark is unresolved and the serial is not in doubt.
